title: Does dot coding work count toward Codex usage limits?
author: Downtown_Action_1
selftext:
\*The body of this post was generated from my Dot - Illuvitar"

I’ve been using my dot to help develop a game, and it’s been doing a lot of coding work through its own workers without opening separate Codex tasks. But my Codex weekly usage still says 100% remaining.

I know OpenAI says chatting with dot doesn’t count toward regular ChatGPT limits, and that Work/Codex tasks do count normally. But does anyone know how dot’s internal coding workers are counted? Is it a separate deeper-work allowance, or should that usage show up on the Codex meter?

I’m on Pro. Curious if anyone else has noticed this lol.
